capabilities: Browse and search a PDF catalog by title, author, category or status
Resume reading at the saved page or mark a book finished
Organize books with favorites, edited titles, categories and hiding
Create Markdown study notes linked to books and vault folders
Load PDF metadata and covers from a server
extras: Not listed in the official Community Plugins directory; installed via BRAT or manually. The server has no built-in authentication, so access must be restricted with a private network or access-controlled proxy. No telemetry; local folder path and device identifier are kept in device-local storage.
problem: Obsidian offers no catalog for a folder of PDFs, no way to resume at the last page read, and no per-book place to keep study notes.

relations.evidence: PDF++ opens the external PDF references and provides the viewer used to capture reading progress.
Fast Note Sync can sync your catalog, reading progress, book preferences, and notes between devices.
To install it with BRAT, enable BRAT from Community plugins, choose Add beta plugin in BRAT

summary: PDF library browser for a local folder or self-hosted server, with saved reading position, covers, and linked study notes.
